parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Uses perpendicular gradient $m_\perp = -\dfrac{1}{2}$ through circle centre $(3, -2)$. — M1
Forms diameter equation $y - (-2) = -\dfrac{1}{2}(x - 3) \implies x + 2y + 1 = 0$. — A1

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Finds contact points by intersecting diameter with circle: $(1, -1)$ and $(5, -3)$. — M1
Writes tangent equations $y - (-1) = 2(x - 1) \implies y = 2x - 3 + 5 = 2x - 3 + ... \implies y = 2x + 2$ and $y - (-3) = 2(x - 5) \implies y = 2x - 18$. — A1
